name: Aiko Watanabe
bio:
Aiko Watanabe's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While many of her peers dreamed of becoming drivers, Aiko was fascinated by the intricate machinery that powered these racing machines. After completing her degree in mechanical engineering, she joined a small local tuning shop where she honed her skills in fabrication and modification. Her dedication and innovative solutions quickly caught the attention of a Chip Ganassi Racing scout. 

Since joining Chip Ganassi Racing, Aiko has proven to be an invaluable asset. She is known for her meticulous attention to detail and ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical issues under immense pressure. While her demanding nature can sometimes ruffle feathers, her colleagues respect her expertise and unwavering commitment to excellence. Aiko believes in continuous improvement and always seeks new ways to optimize performance through innovative fabrication techniques. She insists on precision above all else, ensuring every component meets her exacting standards.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Aiko has a slender build with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to an exact point before starting any task.

Has a collection of miniature tools that she keeps meticulously organized in her locker.
